rationale: The previous iteration increased kd to 1.2 and softened sensor_weights to reduce oscillations and line loss, while slightly increasing base_speed to 1.35 to regain pace. The oval track race completed successfully with no line loss and low steering oscillation, but the s-bend track still caused off-track failure with 2 line loss events and higher steering oscillation (0.50 vs 0.34 on oval). This indicates the controller still struggles with sharp bends and line detection. To address this, I will increase ki from 0.2 to 0.3 to improve integral correction and reduce steady-state error, which may help maintain line tracking on bends. I will also adjust the central sensor's y-position from 0.05 to 0.055 to improve coverage and line detection on curves. If the next race shows stable control and no line loss, I will increase base_speed slightly from 1.35 to 1.4 to improve pace. Geometry otherwise remains unchanged as it has been effective. I continue to request comprehensive observations to monitor completion, progress, errors, line loss events, steering oscillation, and control effort to evaluate these changes.
